name: UAS Bot - FORCE INSTALL (Always runs installation)
author: developer@ativebot.com
description: UAS Bot that FORCES installation to run every time to prevent corrupted file issues
startup: if [[ -d .git ]] && [[ {{AUTO_UPDATE}} == "1" ]]; then git pull; fi; if [[ ! -z ${NODE_PACKAGES} ]]; then /usr/local/bin/npm install ${NODE_PACKAGES}; fi; if [[ ! -z ${UNNODE_PACKAGES} ]]; then /usr/local/bin/npm uninstall ${UNNODE_PACKAGES}; fi; if [ -f /home/container/package.json ]; then /usr/local/bin/npm install; echo "Rebuilding Canvas for container compatibility..."; /usr/local/bin/npm rebuild canvas || echo "Canvas rebuild warning (continuing anyway)"; fi; /usr/local/bin/node "/home/container/${MAIN_FILE}"

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# UAS Bot FORCE INSTALL - Always runs installation logic
# Prevents corrupted file issues by forcing fresh setup

apt update
apt install -y git curl jq file unzip make gcc g++ python3 python3-dev python3-pip libtool

# Install Canvas dependencies
apt install -y libcairo2-dev libpango1.0-dev libjpeg-dev libgif-dev librsvg2-dev pkg-config

echo -e "updating npm. please wait..."
npm install npm@latest --location=global

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "true" ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "1" ]; then
    echo -e "assuming user knows what they are doing have a good day."
    exit 0
fi

## add git ending if it's not on the address
if [[ ${GIT_ADDRESS} != *.git ]]; then
    GIT_ADDRESS=${GIT_ADDRESS}.git
fi

if [ -z "${USERNAME}" ] && [ -z "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
    echo -e "using anon api call"
else
    GIT_ADDRESS="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@$(echo -e ${GIT_ADDRESS} | cut -d/ -f3-)"
fi

# FORCE FRESH CLONE EVERY TIME - Clear directory completely
echo "FORCE INSTALL: Clearing server directory for fresh clone..."
rm -rf /mnt/server/*
rm -rf /mnt/server/.[^.]*

# Always clone fresh
echo -e "/mnt/server cleared. Cloning fresh repository..."
if [ -z ${BRANCH} ]; then
    echo -e "cloning default branch"
    git clone ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
else
    echo -e "cloning ${BRANCH}"
    git clone --single-branch --branch ${BRANCH} ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
fi

# UAS SPECIFIC: Extract from subdirectory - NO /tmp method
if [ -d "uas" ]; then
    echo "Found UAS bot in subdirectory, extracting with NO-TMP method..."
    
    # Step 1: Backup .git in server directory
    mv .git git_backup_temp
    echo "Git directory backed up"
    
    # Step 2: Move UAS contents up using cp and rm to handle conflicts
    echo "Copying UAS files to root (handling directory conflicts)..."
    shopt -s dotglob
    cp -rf uas/* .
    shopt -u dotglob
    echo "UAS files copied to root"
    
    # Remove the uas directory completely
    rm -rf uas
    echo "UAS source directory removed"
    
    # Step 3: Restore .git
    mv git_backup_temp .git
    echo "Git directory restored"
    
    echo "UAS bot extracted successfully (NO-TMP method)"
    
    # Verify extraction worked with detailed output
    if [ -f "/mnt/server/index.js" ] && [ -s "/mnt/server/package.json" ]; then
        echo "SUCCESS: index.js and package.json found with content"
        echo "File sizes:"
        ls -lh /mnt/server/index.js /mnt/server/package.json
        echo "Package.json first line:"
        head -1 /mnt/server/package.json
    else
        echo "ERROR: Files missing or empty after extraction!"
        echo "Contents of /mnt/server:"
        ls -la /mnt/server/
        echo "package.json size:"
        ls -l /mnt/server/package.json 2>/dev/null || echo "package.json does not exist"
        exit 1
    fi
fi

echo "Installing nodejs packages"
if [[ ! -z ${NODE_PACKAGES} ]]; then
    /usr/local/bin/npm install ${NODE_PACKAGES}
fi

if [ -f /mnt/server/package.json ]; then
    echo "Installing dependencies..."
    /usr/local/bin/npm install --production
    echo "Rebuilding Canvas module for container compatibility..."
    /usr/local/bin/npm rebuild canvas || echo "Canvas rebuild warning (module may need fresh install)"
    echo "Canvas rebuild attempted"
fi

echo -e "FORCE INSTALL complete - fresh files guaranteed"
exit 0
